t: Does the Stock Market Run on the Weekend? | Finance - Zacks
s: February 19, 2019 - The time difference between North America and Asia allows trading in Australia and Asian markets when it's Sunday evening in the United States. This is the only "weekend" trading available on physical stock exchanges. A system of after-hours trading arose in the 1990s for those who wished to buy and sell stocks outside of regular market hours.

t: Does Robinhood let you buy and sell on the weekend? - GameRevolution
